title: Bucs at Bengals: Inactives for Week 1

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bucs at Bengals: Inactives for Week 1
sources.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers will be without seven players for Sunday’s season opener against the Cincinnati Bengals at Paycor Stadium. Wide receiver Jalen McMillan, running back Sean Tucker and offensive tackle Justin Skule are inactive after each entered the weekend listed as doubtful because of injuries.
